skill_name: Create a story about a walrus living in the tundra.
workflow:
Once upon a time, there was a walrus living in the tundra of the Arctic Circle. His name was Walter and he was known by all the other animals in the area. He had a number of friends, but nothing could compare to his love for the vast expanse of the tundra.

He spent his days lazing about on the snow or swimming in the icy waters. He loved to explore the coastline, searching for tasty shellfish to eat on the shore. Every now and then he'd run into a fellow walrus were he would serenade the group
